title: In Somnium Scipionis (Latin, Teubner ed. 1868)
author: Macrobius
description: Macrobius's Latin commentary on Cicero's Dream of Scipio explores the soul, dreams and the structure of the cosmos. It became an important bridge between ancient philosophical ideas and medieval understandings of cosmic order.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_vTY_AAAAcAAJ).
